UPDATE meetings SET attendeeId = '17812226737' WHERE id = 690017;

SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, s.companyName,
  dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON dp.attendeeId = m.attendeeId
WHERE m.id = 690017;
